prompt: Zip two parallel lists into a list of PairEntry records, stopping at the shorter one. Complete zip and labels in the starter file.
explanation: Zipping two parallel lists means walking one index over both of them, so the loop bound is the smaller of the two sizes -- that single Math.min is the whole story for the ragged case. A record makes a tidy carrier for the pair: the compiler supplies the constructor and the name()/score() accessors. labels then reads each record back out and formats it, showing that the pairing survives as real data rather than as two lists you have to keep in step by hand.
hints: Use Math.min(names.size(), scores.size()) as the loop bound so the extra entries of the longer list are simply ignored.
Build each pair with new PairEntry(names.get(i), scores.get(i)) and add it to a result ArrayList.
In labels, read the components back with pair.name() and pair.score() -- a record gives you those accessor methods for free.
